blocking_requirements: Fresh official appcast, checksum, and object metadata must reverify the selected artifact before its download.
Every Mac mini system-floor term must be exact and committed in a replacement plan before download or installation.
A version-specific supported no-substitution and automatic-update control must be sourced before first start.
Version-specific first-start internal VM allocation must be avoided by a supported preseed or exactly bounded and separately accepted.
The persisted disk-location setting source/key, default internal disk path, clean-stop method, and placement evidence commands must be version-verified and committed in a replacement plan.
This blocked-design plan must be replaced by a new executable plan ID/hash after all blockers are resolved.
Resolve every Mac mini system-floor term and every null per-action/internal aggregate disk cap from first-party or bounded authorized observations.

Regenerate this plan with numeric system guards, a non-placeholder current-turn authorization reference, authorized=true, and a new SHA-256; this blocked artifact cannot be edited in place or executed.
Bind the eventual driver to B2AExecutionSupervisor so every adjacent guard, action order, call count, deadline, output/download/disk delta, free-space floor, and zero-retry rule is enforced.
Close the storage-guard identity race by binding fresh diskutil UUID evidence to held mount descriptors and re-observing identity at guard consumption.

Add version-specific machine evidence and supervisor wiring for Docker stopped state, settings and VM-file placement, default-internal inactivity, and reconnect identity before any executable replacement plan.
Replace prose-only rollback with a typed fail-state executor that enforces the exact one-time detach, verified Docker stop, evidence retention, and no-deletion contract.
Provide an authorized in-process driver that mints and consumes the supervisor-owned writer-closure capability; the standalone seal-and-copy CLI remains disabled.
rollback_cleanup: Stop immediately on every failed guard, limit, identity, user attestation, or evidence check; authorize no retry.
If the DMG is mounted, attempt exactly one clean hdiutil detach of /Volumes/Docker and retain failure evidence.
If Docker Desktop is running, require the user to Quit it and machine-verify stopped state before reconnect or sealing.
Do not uninstall Docker Desktop automatically, delete a default internal VM disk, remove external Docker state, or delete any user file.
Retain the verified DMG, all local B2a evidence, failed staging trees, and the sealed source; do not reuse attempt or archive identities.
Remove no external directory or artifact automatically; any later disposition requires a separately reviewed exact target.

steps.instruction: Personally review and accept the applicable Docker Desktop terms. Record only a timestamp, displayed product version/build, and attestation; Codex must not click, accept, or attest.

Before permitting an engine start, disable automatic download/update or version substitution through the current officially supported Docker Desktop 4.85.0 control and attest the exact displayed setting. If no such pre-start control is available, stop.

In Docker Desktop Settings -> Resources -> Advanced -> Disk image location, select exactly /Volumes/Macintosh HD - Data/GIC-Lab/t07/docker-desktop/disk-image and record the user-action timestamp. Do not move a VM file manually in Finder.
Use Docker Desktop's Apply/Restart control exactly once after the machine guard rechecks both volumes. Stop on migration, substitution, update, default-internal activity, or unbounded allocation.
Permit one cropped screenshot containing only Docker Desktop version/build and the Disk image location control. Exclude account, proxy, sharing, credential, extension, and unrelated settings.
Quit Docker Desktop cleanly and wait for machine evidence that its engine/backend is stopped and no process has the exact external VM file open.
After machine-confirmed Docker stop, eject the MacBook Data volume, disconnect the Target Disk Mode link, and attest the physical-action timestamp. Do not restart Docker.
Reconnect Target Disk Mode and remount/unlock the MacBook Data volume. Attest only the physical/user-action timestamp; do not start Docker before machine requalification.
Quit Docker Desktop again and wait for machine verification of final stopped state, no open external VM file, and no active default internal VM disk before evidence sealing.

stop_conditions: The plan status or authorization remains false, or any blocking requirement remains unresolved.
Repository branch, implementation ancestry, plan hash, worktree cleanliness, or locked scientific hashes differ.
Either storage UUID, exact mount, APFS/writable/unlocked/UTDM state, path ancestry, device role, or free-space guard fails.
Any system-floor term remains unknown or observed system free space is below the resolved floor.
Current official metadata, DMG byte size/SHA-256, installed version/build, or update policy differs.
Any first-party bootstrap allocation is unclassified/unbounded, or any T07 workload image/container/browser/API/secret action appears.
Disk location, exact VM file identity, default internal inactivity, engine/context identity, or reconnect state cannot be proven mechanically.
Any per-action or aggregate wall, output, download, internal/external disk, evidence, or retry limit would be exceeded.
The user declines or cannot personally complete a required terms, GUI, stop, eject, reconnect, unlock, or restart action.
Evidence cannot be completely sealed, copied, destination-hash verified, and retained locally.
